references.title: HGPflow: Extending Hypergraph Particle Flow to Collider Event Reconstruction
references.finding: Uses tracks/calorimeter objects and an incidence structure; calorimeter incidence targets refer to particle contributions to cluster energy.
references.applicability: Shows why real associations and resolved payload matter. PHYS SpacePoint counts/endpoint chords are neither particle-level targets nor constituent energies. Does not justify another geometry network without product support.
